purpose: Display wiring and argument contract for the Bloodstream description (facts only).

files.hooks/load.lua: loads /data-chn-mod/chn_supplement.lua and calls dynamic_desc_fixes.install() in ToME:load

display_paths: English (locale not zh_hans): original upstream info, upstream key with the arguments above.
Chinese, BLOODSTREAM_ZH_KEY translated in the current locale: BLOODSTREAM_ZH_KEY:tformat(weapon damage %, getDuration, getDamage, damDesc(PHYSICAL, getDamage)).

Chinese, BLOODSTREAM_ZH_KEY not translated, or any error in that path, or an add-on build without this hook: original upstream info, i.e. the upstream key's Chinese (the entry under review) with getDamageInc as the third argument.
addon.dedicated_key_source:
You "gently" slam your saws into the wounds of a creature, dealing %d%% weapon damage and deepening the wounds.
		If the attack hits, the target was already bleeding before the attack and is still bleeding after it, that bleeding effect's duration is increased by %d turns and its damage becomes %d%% of its current value (this may be done only once per bleeding effect).
		When this happens a gush of blood is projected in a narrow cone of radius 4, dealing %0.2f physical damage to all creatures.
		The power and damage improves with your Steampower.
		#{italic}#The marvels of technology, now at the service of true butchery!#{normal}###chn-mod bloodstream actual multiplier
addon.dedicated_key_target:
你“轻柔”地将链锯猛砸进目标的伤口，造成 %d%% 武器伤害并加深伤口。
		若攻击命中，且攻击前目标已在流血、命中后流血效果仍在，则该流血效果持续时间延长 %d 回合，伤害变为原来的 %d%% （每个流血效果只能强化一次）。
		效果触发时，血流将喷射而出，对半径 4 的窄锥形范围内所有生物造成 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		效果强度和伤害受蒸汽强度加成。
		#{italic}#科技的奇迹，如今为真正的屠戮效力！#{normal}#
